# Annotated system

Model: `diagram-annotated-energy`. Each call creates a complete slide. Inter, geometry and text sizes are fixed.

[Model index](../../../templates/MODELS.md) · [Palette and content guide](../../STUDIO-MODELS.md)

```latex
\studiosetup{palette=light}
\studiotemplate[variant=default]{diagram-annotated-energy}
```

Palette switches are available only where the original composition exists in both colours.
Unsupported explicit choices fail. A global palette leaves special compositions in their native treatment.

## Variants and named fields

### default

Original palettes: light.

[Current source](../../../templates/studio/diagram-annotated-energy.tex) · [Full slot guide](../guides/diagram-annotated-energy.md)

| Field | Default | Available space |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | <code>Slide title</code> | 32.8% wide × 8.5% high |
| `label-two` | <code>Label 2</code> | 10.7% wide × 3.5% high |
| `label-three` | <code>Item</code> | 5.6% wide × 3.8% high |
| `label-four` | <code>Item</code> | 5.2% wide × 3.7% high |
| `label-five` | <code>Label 5</code> | 10.1% wide × 7.3% high |
| `label-six` | <code>Item</code> | 7.0% wide × 7.3% high |
| `label-seven` | <code>Item</code> | 4.1% wide × 3.1% high |
| `label-eight` | <code>Supporting explanation</code> | 54.4% wide × 3.1% high |
| `label-nine` | <code>Item</code> | 4.9% wide × 3.2% high |

Graphic slots also accept named `icon-one`, `image-one`, `graphic-one` keys (then two, three, …), following their stable slot numbers. See the full slot guide for position and bounds.

Omitted fields retain these descriptive defaults; empty values retain their allocated space. Numbers and charts are illustrative.

## Complete one-slide example

```latex
\documentclass[aspectratio=169]{beamer}
\usetheme{bitpolito-studio}
\usepackage{bitpolitostudiotemplates}
\usepackage[backend=biber]{biblatex}
\addbibresource{bibliography.bib}
\begin{document}
\studiotemplate[
  variant={default},
  palette={light},
  title={Slide title},
  label-two={Label 2}
]{diagram-annotated-energy}
\end{document}
```
